title: Pokemon Tatsugiri ex 142/191 Surging Sparks Tera Rare NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokémon TCG — Tatsugiri ex (Tera), #142/191, Surging Sparks (SV8).
Basic, HP 160. Tera Pokémon — while on your Bench, prevents all attack damage to this Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). Attacks: Surprise Pump (100 dmg), Cinnabar Lure. Pokémon ex rule — opponent takes 2 Prize cards on KO. Illustrated by 5ban Graphics.
Ungraded, near mint or better — see photos for the actual card. Ships sleeved in a top-loader inside a rigid mailer.
